hypotheses: The frozen cached Q24 Normal-only Fortress port retains the floating champion playing behavior closely enough for release without adding search or hidden information.
analysis: Fixed numerical/integration port validation, not strategy optimization. Primary paired95% candidate-minus-champion score interval must have lower endpoint above -0.02 separately in DOS and honest endpoint. No pooling, tuning, sample extension or equivalence claim.
